definitions.explanation: A clock designed to be hung on a wall. The most common type of clock found in homes, offices, and classrooms in Japan.

examples.japanese: {掛|か}け{時計|どけい}が{止|と}まっている。
{新|あたら}しい{掛|か}け{時計|どけい}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a new wall clock.

examples.japanese: {教室|きょうしつ}の{掛|か}け{時計|どけい}を{見|み}ると、もう{午後|ごご}{三時|さんじ}だった。
examples.english: When I looked at the classroom wall clock, it was already 3 PM.

notes:
Compound of {掛|か}け (hanging) and {時計|とけい} (clock). The と in {時計|とけい} voices to ど in the compound due to rendaku.

RELATED WORDS:
- {置|お}き{時計|どけい} — table clock; desk clock
- {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい} — alarm clock
- {腕時計|うでどけい} — wristwatch
- {電波時計|でんぱどけい} — radio-controlled clock (automatically syncs to atomic time signals)
- {柱時計|はしらどけい} — pillar clock; old-fashioned wall clock hung on a pillar

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {掛|か}け{時計|どけい}を{掛|か}ける — to hang a wall clock
- {掛|か}け{時計|どけい}の{電池|でんち}を{替|か}える — to replace the battery of a wall clock
- {掛|か}け{時計|どけい}が{遅|おく}れている — the wall clock is running slow
